title: Tissue Procurement: Normal Colon
author: Kerry Wiles
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6y9hfz6

steps.title: Identify and Prepare Colon Tissue
steps.instruction: Identify the target tissue in the surgical pathology laboratory, ensuring it is either normal adjacent tissue (NAT) in cancerous colons or histologically normal diverticulitis colon tissue.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the colon length is opened and cleaned of withheld matter by a resident pathologist or PA.

steps.title: Collect Tissue Section
steps.instruction: Collect a section of colon that exhibits both the mucosa and the muscularis.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the section is large enough for all desired collection methods (snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen, frozen in OCT, paraffin fixation, fresh shipping, etc.).
Verify the tissue is free of significant necrosis and, if NAT, free of all non-normal tissue.

steps.title: Trim and Prepare Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the procured tissue for preservation at the CHTN laboratory.

substeps.instruction: Trim off and dispose of visible attached fat unless otherwise requested.
Differentiate between the internal mucosa and the external muscularis layer.

steps.title: Excise QA Section
steps.instruction: Cut away a small Quality Assurance (QA) section from the center of the colon sample.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the QA section represents both the mucosa and the muscularis.
Ensure the QA section is free of adipose tissue.

steps.title: Portion Tissue for Preservation
steps.instruction: Divide the tissue into portions based on CHTN database specifications for dimensions, weights, and collection methods.

substeps.instruction: If using NAT colon, cut away any inked tissue before preservation.
Generally divide the tissue into equal numbers of paraffin blocks, frozen OCT samples, snap-frozen full-cut samples (displaying both mucosa and muscularis), and snap-frozen mucosa-only samples.

steps.title: Prepare Mucosa-Only Samples
steps.instruction: Shear a short length of the lining away from the muscularis using dissection scissors or a razor blade.

substeps.instruction: Label clamshells containing only mucosa as 'mucosa-only'.
Include 'mucosa-only' in the descriptors of the tissue acquisition page of the CHTN database.

steps.title: Prepare Snap-Frozen Full-Cut Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare snap-frozen full-cut colon samples weighing approximately 0.25g.

steps.title: Prepare Paraffin Block Samples
steps.instruction: Cut paraffin block samples into long, thin strips (less than 0.5cm thick).

substeps.instruction: Ensure strips show both the mucosa and the muscularis of the colon.

steps.title: Prepare OCT Frozen Samples
steps.instruction: Freeze normal colon samples in OCT following the general protocol for OCT fixation.

substeps.instruction: Ensure samples display both the mucosa and the muscularis unless otherwise requested.
